axes_ranked.axis: S1 test-time context (best arm = v1.0 default)

unexcluded_rivals: S1: the 6/9s arms concatenate DIFFERENT same-speaker utterances, since no eval prompt is longer than 3.5s. Multi-utterance context is confounded with length; a single long utterance was never tested.
S1/S2/S3/S4: all measured on one corpus, one codec, one language, and C-budget models only. No axis was tested at budget D or at 90k steps.
S2: candidates come from ONE model at T=8. Best-of-K across different checkpoints or temperatures is untested and could behave differently.

S2: ECAPA and WavLM-SV are both WavLM/x-vector-family speaker encoders. A genuinely independent scorer family (e.g. a d-vector or a fine-tuned ASR-speaker hybrid) was not available and is not excluded as a shared-bias rival.
S4: only three gamma values, one guidance form, and the wrong-speaker negative is a single fixed assignment (i+7); other negatives were not tried.

H-S0: the ceiling is defined by a Mimi roundtrip of the GT TARGET. A perfect system might exceed it by matching the prompt channel more closely than the target recording does -- checked as a rival and not excluded, only bounded.
